title: Hiking in the Wild: A Scalable Perceptive Parkour Framework for Humanoids
abstract: arXiv:2601.07718v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Achieving robust humanoid locomotion in complex, unstructured environments requires transitioning from reactive proprioception to proactive perception. However, integrating exteroception remains a significant challenge: existing approaches often fail to achieve high-speed, stable locomotion across diverse, unstructured terrains. In this work, we present Hiking in the Wild, an extensible, end-to-end perceptive legged parkour framework designed for robust humanoid hiking. Our approach maps depth inputs and proprioception directly to joint actions, without relying on external localization and mapping. To ensure safety and training stability, we introduce two key mechanisms: a foothold safety mechanism combining extensible Terrain Edge Detection with Foot Volume Points to reduce catastrophic slippage on edges, and a Flat Patch Sampling strategy that mitigates reward hacking by generating feasible navigation targets. translated_title: 荒野徒步：一种可扩展的人形机器人感知跑酷框架
translated_abstract: 在复杂、非结构化环境中实现稳健的人形机器人运动，需要从被动的本体感知转向主动的环境感知。然而，外部感知的集成仍然是一个重大挑战：现有方法通常无法在多样、非结构化的地形上实现高速、稳定的运动。在这项工作中，我们提出了 Hiking in the Wild，一个可扩展的端到端感知型足式跑酷框架，专为稳健的人形机器人徒步而设计。我们的方法将深度输入和本体感知直接映射到关节动作，而无需依赖外部定位与建图。为了确保安全性和训练稳定性，我们引入了两个关键机制：一是落脚点安全机制，结合了可扩展的地形边缘检测与足部体积点，以减少在边缘处的灾难性滑落；二是平坦区域采样策略，通过生成可行的导航目标来缓解奖励作弊问题。大量的实验……
tldr: 本文提出一个端到端的感知型人形机器人跑酷框架，通过将深度图像和本体感知直接映射为关节动作，并引入地形边缘检测与平坦区域采样等安全稳定机制，实现人形机器人在非结构化复杂地形上无需外部定位建图的高速稳健徒步运动。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an end-to-end perceptive parkour framework that enables humanoids to hike robustly at high speed across unstructured terrains by directly mapping depth inputs and proprioception to joint actions, aided by safety mechanisms such as terrain edge detection and flat patch sampling without relying on external localization and mapping.
